auditItems.change: New bookings retain an explicit IANA appointment zone; DST gaps/repeated times fail closed. Historical unzoned records are not silently reinterpreted.
Token and personal-account edits share lifecycle and merchant-touch restrictions.
Current merchant entitlement is checked inside admission and CAS retries, not inferred from cached published rules.
Device-independent /booking-manage links retain bearer credentials in the fragment, not a request URL.
Merchant restore and batch restore preflight capacity, including joint occupancy.
New public bookings and customer rescheduling reject past or invalid appointment times.
Client nonce, principal-bound durable command results, CAS admission and lost-response recovery prevent duplicate creates in atomic-v2.
Invalid tokens cannot start automation; atomic-v2 reads never send messages, merge local files or perform read-repair.
Bounded central email transport, truthful uncertain outcomes and a durable private notification dispatcher are implemented.
Private per-merchant Reply-To supports customer replies without exposing merchant mailbox passwords. Format validation is not mailbox ownership verification.

completedRecommendations: Reservation changes, scoped configuration, command deduplication and notification intents commit together in atomic-v2.
Lease-owned dispatch requires a receipt before reporting sent. Unknown sends are not requeued; definite HTTP 429 retries are bounded to three attempts.
Reminder queue ownership survives bounded timeline trimming, without creating a false sent log.
Desktop and mobile retain dirty drafts across pagination, refresh and reopened details; stale response generations cannot replace a newer list.
Persistent stale-cache warnings and last-sync indicators distinguish cached data from current server results.
Day/week agenda and loaded-record capacity summaries are available on desktop and mobile. They are explicitly not authoritative availability.
Booking workbench shows missing central mail configuration or disabled queued-worker warnings without revealing secrets.
Operational browser acceptances run in the existing mandatory browser CI job; old release policies and required checks remain unchanged.

verification.runtime: Windows, Node 24.13.1; local verification is not hosted Linux/Node 20 release CI

postgresAcceptance.networkAndMessages: Loopback-only owned database; injected synthetic email transport; no production credentials or real sends.

browserAcceptance.network: All requests intercepted before navigation; unexpected paths/origins fail.

isolatedBuild.dependencies: Fresh private npm ci; shared worktree node_modules untouched; pinned WASM guard retained.
isolatedBuild.environment: Synthetic Supabase public values, no provider/service credentials, background jobs paused.

requiresSeparateApprovalAndVerification: A migration-aware release scope, complete hosted CI, bounded build, smoke checks, compatible rollback and version retention. Do not widen or reuse old login/attendance code-only lanes.
Reconcile legacy local JSON and authoritative rows without overwriting historical bookings; verify actual private pages/RPC ACLs and all configuration/backup writers.

Quiesce every incompatible booking web writer, GET-triggered automation and timer before activating a compatible database generation. A database fence cannot undo a send performed before a rejected old write.
Verify the central sender/domain and send a separately approved real recipient test, including Reply-To, management/calendar links, customer reminders and merchant notifications.
Enable only the compatible application/worker cohort after the database gate passes; never fall back to legacy IO after an atomic error.
limitations: Global JSON-store CAS is deliberately coarse; no normalized-storage scalability or performance claim is made.
Stable HTTP retry identities currently cover public creation/recovery. Manual email callers must not treat an unknown request result as permission to resend.
Local verification does not establish production sender configuration, actual delivery or live feature activation.
